**What to Expect**
This position is expected to begin around January/February 2027 and continue through April/May 2027\. Internships at Tesla are generally full\-time, onsite roles that last a minimum of 12 weeks.


International Students: If your work authorization is via CPT, consult your school regarding your ability to work 40 hours per week before applying. You must be able to work 40 hours per week onsite. Many students will be limited to part\-time during the academic year.


About the Team


Service Engineering is responsible for real\-time diagnostic support for the service network (the field), development and improvement of diagnostic tools and procedures, and feedback of top field issues to our development teams to improve current and future products. Tesla is seeking an intern that is passionate about the product, a strong critical thinker, and capable of understanding technical system\-level architecture and issues.

 **What You'll Do**
Your application will be considered for the teams listed below that all fall under Service Engineering:
Toolbox: Responsible for developing and maintaining the primary diagnostic and repair platform used by technicians in Tesla Service Centers, independent repair shops, and even by vehicle owners at home. Our goal is to create intuitive, user\-friendly tools that streamline the diagnostic and repair process, reducing the time and complexity associated with vehicle maintenance. jobs.description:
**The opportunity**


The team behind Unity’s visionOS support, Play\-to\-Device, and Record \& Playback is growing as we prepare for something even more ambitious: adapting PolySpatial to stream Unity content into other game engines and 3D environments — in\-process, cross\-process, and over the network.


We're looking for engineers eager to help us invent how different real\-time 3D runtimes communicate and render under real\-world constraints. You’ll work at the intersection of graphics, core game engine tech, high\-performance networking, distributed systems, and emerging AI/ML\-assisted workflows. This is your opportunity to build the fundamental infrastructure for the next generation of interconnected games and intelligent 3D ecosystems.


You'll bridge Unity content into other renderers, maintaining fidelity and performance within a renderer we don't own. This requires a rare mix of artistic instincts, low\-level API knowledge, and the systems engineering skills to build a robust pipeline. If you prefer solving hard rendering problems at the systems level—shader translation, resource lifetime, visual equivalence—more than chasing one\-off visual features, you'll find this work deeply satisfying.

**What you'll be doing**

* Map Unity graphics and rendering features onto third\-party renderers while preserving visual consistency and performance.
* Develop compact scene\-state representations and compression strategies for meshes, materials, textures, animations, transforms, deltas, and dependency graphs across local and networked execution
* Engineer robust graphical systems that remain stable and resource\-efficient even when scaled to massive user\-generated content libraries
* Profile and optimize end\-to\-end rendering for high framerates and fidelity while minimizing overhead and sync stalls

**What we're looking for**

* **Multi\-Engine Fluency:** Significant experience with Unity's rendering architecture, and at least one other high\-end renderer (Unreal, Frostbite, etc).
* **Shader \& API Depth****:** Strong understanding of shader languages (HLSL/GLSL/Metal) and graphics APIs (DirectX, Vulkan, Metal), and the ability to translate between them.
* **Pipeline Mindset:**You understand the full asset lifecycle—from authoring through import, batching, streaming, and rendering—including shader compilation, mesh processing, and texture streaming.
* **Systems\-First Engineer:**You prioritize building stable, scalable, maintainable systems over chasing the latest graphics techniques.

**You might also have**

* Experience writing shader cross\-compilers, AST manipulators, or shader graph backends.
* Background in networked graphics APIs, pixel\-based streaming, cloud rendering, or virtualized GPUs.
* Experience building deterministic record/replay systems for rendering, simulation, networking, testing, or debugging.
* Familiarity with MCPs, agentic tool frameworks, AI\-assisted content pipelines, synthetic data generation, ML\-based asset optimization, or automated scene analysis.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ads Data Platform
jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 41961
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're building the data foundation that makes advertising on Roblox possible. As a Senior Engineering Manager you'll lead a team of engineers building the systems that turn raw signal into trustworthy, privacy\-safe, actionable data across five connected domains: core data infrastructure, identity, measurement, audience targeting, and feature engineering for ML.



This is a hands\-on leadership role at the center of our monetization strategy. Your team's work determines whether advertisers can reach the right audiences, prove positive ROI, and trust the numbers we report, all while upholding the privacy and safety standards our platform is known for. You'll set technical direction, grow a high\-performing team, and partner closely with product, data science, privacy/legal, and the broader Ads organization.


**You Will**
------------

* Build and lead a team of high\-caliber software engineers. You'll be responsible for hiring, performance management, career development, and fostering an inclusive, high\-output team culture.
* Set and communicate a multi\-quarter technical roadmap across core data, identity, measurement, targeting, and the ML feature platform, and make the prioritization and buy\-vs\-build calls that keep the team focused on the highest\-leverage work.
* Partner with product management, data science, ML engineering, privacy/legal, and adjacent Ads and Data Platform teams to translate business goals into a coherent, well\-sequenced engineering plan.
* Raise the bar on engineering quality across system design, data correctness, reliability (SLAs/SLOs), and operational excellence for systems that run continuously at massive scale.
* Champion privacy\-by\-design and responsible data handling as a first\-class requirement, not an afterthought, in every system your team builds.
* Represent your team's work and trade\-offs to senior leadership, and communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

**You Have**
------------


* 8\+ years in software engineering with 3\+ years managing engineers, including hiring and performance management.
* Experience delivering large\-scale distributed data systems, data pipelines, streaming/batch processing, and data stores handling high volume and low latency.
* Strong foundation in at least one of: identity resolution, ad measurement/attribution, audience targeting/segmentation, or feature/data pipelines for ML.
* Demonstrated ability to set technical direction and successfully lead teams through ambiguity
* Excellent cross\-functional collaboration and communication skills
* Working knowledge of data privacy principles and regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, COPPA) and a genuine commitment to building privacy\-safe systems.


For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**.


Annual Salary Range

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
* About the role: Credo is seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to join our Security Team. This role will be responsible for advancing the organization's Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC), identifying and mitigating application security risks, and partnering closely with software, firmware, and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.  

  

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in application security, secure coding practices, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps. This individual will act as a security advisor to engineering teams and help drive security initiatives across software, firmware, cloud, and AI\-enabled development environments.  

  

Base salary range is $100,000 \- $150,000 a year. The base salary offer will depend on factors such as education, experience, training, skills, qualifications, and location. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity and a full range of medical and other benefits.  

  

Why Credo  

  

Purpose: We invest in what matters. From meaningful\-future shaping projects to competitive compensation, we empower you to grow your career while making a lasting impact.  

People: Connection starts within. We collaborate, celebrate wins, and create an environment where everyone can do their best work.  

Possibilities: Our belief shapes what’s next. Our technology powers the most reliable and energy\-efficient connections around the world – and our team powers new products and markets that come next.

  
Qualifications: Basic Qualifications  

5\+ years in application/product security with hands‑on work in secure design, threat modeling, code review, and vulnerability management.  

Secure SDLC leadership including 3\+ years implementing or managing SDLC programs and partnering with engineering teams throughout the lifecycle.  

Strong application security expertise including secure coding principles, architecture reviews, API security, and remediation guidance.  

Technical depth in C, C\+\+, and Python with experience reviewing and securing applications in these languages.  

DevSecOps and automation proficiency including GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, SAST/DAST/SCA, container security, and security automation tooling.  

Cross‑functional communication with the ability to mentor developers, influence secure development practices, and support audits or customer assessments.  

  

Preferred Qualifications  

  

Embedded and hardware security experience across semiconductor, networking, ASIC, or similar environments.  

Firmware and ASIC security, including securing embedded software and hardware‑adjacent applications.  

AI‑assisted development security and strong familiarity with secure AI usage patterns.  

Cloud security expertise across AWS, Azure, and GCP.  

Knowledge of security frameworks including STRIDE, NIST SSDF, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001\.  

Relevant certifications such as GWAPT or GIAC GWEB.  
* Secure SDLC leadership with a track record of partnering with engineering leadership to improve product security.

  
Responsibilities: Secure SDLC Implementation  

  

Implementation and continuous improvement of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) program.  

Partner with engineering leadership to embed security requirements into software and firmware development processes.  

Define security standards, secure coding guidelines, and security gates across the development lifecycle.  

Drive adoption of security\-by\-design principles across products and services.  

  

Application Security  

  

Conduct application security reviews, architecture reviews, and threat modeling exercises.  

Perform source code reviews and security assessments of internally developed applications and products.  

Identify, assess, prioritize, and track remediation of application security vulnerabilities.  

Support penetration testing activities and coordinate remediation efforts with development teams.  

Evaluate security risks associated with new technologies, frameworks, and third\-party components.  

  

DevSecOps \& Automation  

  

Implement and manage SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets Scanning, Container Security, and CI/CD security controls.  
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate security testing and vulnerability management processes.

  
*About Credo: Credo’s mission is to transform connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy\-efficient system solutions. Our high\-speed copper and optical interconnect products deliver industry\-leading power and performance at up to 1\.6T to meet the ever\-expanding data infrastructure demands of AI.  

  

Our product portfolio includes ZeroFlap (ZF) Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and ZF optical transceivers, OmniConnect memory solutions, and a suite of retimers and DSPs for optical and copper Ethernet and PCIe, all leveraging the PILOT diagnostic and analytics software platform. Credo innovations enable our customers to connect the systems that connect the world.

jobs.title: Robotics Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
**Robotics Engineering Lead**
**Santa Rosa, CA**
**Full Time**  

***(Relocation Assistance Available)***

  

**Summary:**
As our Robotics Engineering Lead, you will own the automation of targeted manufacturing processes from concept to a running in production. You will assess which operations are the best candidates for automation, select the right technology, and then roll up your sleeves to make it real — integrating collaborative robots (cobots) for assembly, handling, and test tasks, and deploying autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) to move material intelligently across the floor. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you will be the deepest robotics expert in the our organization, setting the technical direction while personally programming, integrating, and commissioning the systems, and mentoring the engineers and technicians who work alongside you.  


**Responsibilities:**
* Identify and prioritize manufacturing processes that are strong candidates for automation, building the business and technical case for each.


* Design, program, integrate, and commission collaborative robot (cobot) for tasks such as assembly, material handling, machine tending, inspection, and test.


* Deploy and integrate autonomous mobile robots AMRs for material movement, including route planning, fleet coordination, and hand\-offs to workstations.


* Own end\-to\-end delivery: requirements, concept design, simulation, build, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), validation, and production hand\-off.


* Integrate robots, sensors, vision, and end\-effectors with existing factory equipment and production lines.


* Serve as the hands\-on technical lead: set standards, review designs, and mentor engineers, technicians, and operators moving into robotics.


* Evaluate and manage robot, cobot, AMR, and integration vendors; run pilots and scale the technologies that prove out.


* Partner with the Keysight safety team to review designs, complete risk assessments, and ensure each robot and mobile robot deployment meets safety requirements before going live.


* Develop and maintain documentation, run\-books, and training so that production teams can operate and sustain each deployment.

  


**Required:**
* Bachelor, Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent industry research experience).


* 3\+ years of experience in industrial automation or robotics, including deploying systems in a live manufacturing or production environment.


* Strong mix of both software and mechanical engineering.


* Hands\-on experience programming and integrating collaborative robots (e.g., Universal Robots or similar) and their end\-effectors, grippers, and vision.


* Experience with AMRs and material\-handling automation, including deployment and integration on a factory floor.


* Experience with cobot simulation and offline programming tools to validate cobot cell layouts, cycle times, and reachability before physical deployment.


* Demonstrated ability to lead a project and mentor others while remaining personally hands\-on with the technical work.


* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

  


**Preferred:**
* Experience with ROS / ROS 2 and robot simulation or digital\-twin tools (e.g., RobotStudio, RoboDK, or vendor equivalents).


* Familiarity with 2D/3D machine vision, force/torque control, and pick\-and\-place applications.


* AMR fleet management and integration with warehouse / manufacturing execution systems.


* Experience in electronics or precision, high\-mix / low\-volume manufacturing.


* Proficiency with CAD (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD) for tooling and layout.


* Vendor certifications in relevant robot or cobot platforms.


* Working knowledge of machine safety standards and risk assessment for robotic and collaborative applications (e.g., ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 12100, ISO 13849\).

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Nscale**



Nscale is the GPU cloud built for AI. We run high\-performance, cost\-efficient infrastructure for AI\-native  

startups and global enterprises, from bare metal up through the platform services teams actually build  

on. Our culture runs on ownership, accountability, and speed. We move with urgency, we tell each  

other the truth, and everyone here stays close to the infrastructure that makes AI work.

  

**The Role**  

This is a career\-level SRE role for someone who wants to own systems, not just watch them. You'll take  

real surface area: the automation and tooling other engineers depend on, and the reliability of  

production services running AI and GPU workloads at scale. You'll sit in the incident rotation, and you'll  

be expected to make the systems you touch quieter over time.

  

**What You'll Do**  

* Build and own the automation and tooling that keeps the platform running; treat operational toil as


a bug to be fixed, not a fact of life.  

* Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and the dashboards that make service health obvious at a glance.
* Take point during incidents; troubleshoot under pressure, drive root cause analysis, and run post\-


incident reviews that actually change the system.  

* Investigate performance and reliability problems across Linux, networking, and distributed services,


then fix them at the source.  

* Partner with Engineering, Networking, and Infrastructure teams to raise the reliability bar across the


stack.  

* Improve availability, scalability, and efficiency through code, not manual effort.


What You'll Bring  

* 3\-6 years in SRE, systems engineering, or software engineering, including time running production in


a data center or cloud environment.  

* Strong programming skills (Python, Go, or similar) and a genuine bias toward automating the work


away.  

* Solid command of Linux, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems.
* A track record of troubleshooting live production issues and owning the fix through to the retro.
* Fluency with monitoring and observability; metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Comfort in a fast\-moving environment where priorities shift and you fill gaps without waiting to be


asked.  

**Nice to Have**  

* Experience with AI or GPU workloads, or high\-performance computing (HPC).
* Familiarity with high\-performance networking (InfiniBand, RDMA).
* Kubernetes, plus virtualized or bare\-metal environments.


On\-Call and Pace  

A quick note on the shape of the job. This role sits close to production, so there is an on\-call rotation,  

and some weeks are busier than others. We share it fairly, and we treat every page as a signal worth  

acting on rather than just an interruption. The goal is to make the systems quieter over time, so each  

rotation asks less of the person carrying it. If you take ownership of what you run and like leaving it in  

better shape than you found it, you'll do well here.  

What We Offer  

* Competitive base plus equity, reviewed every 12 months.
* Real scope early, and a progression plan built around the skills you want to sharpen.
* Flexibility that treats you as an adult; we care that the work gets done, and we trust you to shape


your day.  

**Salary Range**  

$130,000 \- $200,000 USD. Actual compensation varies with skill set, experience, and location, and the  

role may be eligible for bonus and equity.

  



Equal Opportunities Statement



At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds.



If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

*For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.*

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe Firefly is redefining how people create, not only inside Adobe's own apps, but increasingly wherever creativity happens. Our generative AI is now reaching users directly through third\-party agentic surfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, where people call Adobe's tools without ever opening a traditional Adobe product. Understanding how these experiences are adopted, where they delight, and where they fall short is one of the most exciting and least\-charted data problems at the company.
  
  

We're looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to help us make sense of it. You'll build the data foundations and generate the insights that shape how our Firefly agent, and the tools it exposes across partner platforms, evolves. You'll partner closely with our Third\-Party (3P) team, which owns how Firefly is accessed through external agents and assistants, while staying connected to the broader Firefly data picture. This is a hands\-on role for someone who loves
  
turning messy, high\-volume, ambiguous data into production\-ready pipelines and decisions leadership can act on fast.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
**Design and analyze experiments:** conduct sound statistical analysis (hypothesis testing, A/B experimentation), recognizing errors and biases and weighing the pros and cons of approaches within the business context.
  
**Turn data into direction:** identify patterns and actionable insights that inform product strategy, prioritization, and roadmap decisions for the Firefly agent and its tools across partner platforms.
  
**Be a data steward:** develop deep domain intuition for the agentic/3P ecosystem, take on ambiguous business problems, and make well\-reasoned assumptions grounded in that understanding.
  
**Tell the story:** interpret, simplify, and synthesize results for technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and communicate findings that help decision\-makers move quickly and confidently.
  
**Own end\-to\-end data products:** Support our data engineering team with the build and maintenance of scalable, automated, and reliable data pipelines that consolidate diverse, high\-volume, and often unstructured usage data from across Adobe's agentic and third\-party surfaces.
  
**Write production\-quality code:** apply best practices in coding, testing, and architecture design; review others' code and provide effective feedback; and build tools and processes that benefit multiple teams.
  
**Drive projects to completion:** independently manage one or more technical projects start to finish with minimal managerial guidance, and begin to lead initiatives that inform broader team strategy and goals.
  
**Partner cross\-functionally:** collaborate with Product Management, Engineering,
  
Design, and partner\-facing teams to define customer\-focused, measurable solutions.
  
**Raise the bar:** mentor junior data scientists/engineers, share knowledge across and beyond the immediate team, and help establish best practices; contribute to hiring through technical interviewing.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
6\+ years of relevant experience in data science, data/ML engineering, or analytics engineering.
  
A relevant Bachelor's degree and/or advanced degree in a quantitative or engineering field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.
  
Strong skills in at least one programming/data\-manipulation language (e.g., Python, SQL, Scala) and the ability to query and integrate data from multiple disparate sources.
  
Proven experience architecting and maintaining scalable, automated data pipelines and owning large\-scale data products across multiple data sources and integrations.
  
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation, with the judgment to recognize bias and error and to interpret results in a business context.
  
Excellent data storytelling, able to synthesize complex analysis for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
  
Comfort with ambiguity and unstructured problems; a self\-directed worker who thrives with minimal structure.
  
**Bonus:** exposure to LLM/agentic products, product analytics for AI/ML applications, or usage\-data instrumentation for platform or partner ecosystems

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking**Full Stack Software Engineers** who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. As a Capital One Lead Software Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.

**About the Team:**


 The Consumer Travel team is dedicated to crafting exceptional end\-to\-end experiences for our customers. As a high\-impact, full\-stack engineering team, we work closely with both our end users and core platform teams across the organization.  

Our engineers own shared foundational components utilized across multiple engineering groups, while also driving key features like innovative fintech travel products. If you thrive on making an immediate impact on customer experience and leading high\-visibility, cross\-team initiatives, we would love to have you join us!


The travel organization leverages modern technologies to build performant, scalable services, using React for the front\-end and Scala for the back\-end.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* At least 4 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)
* At least 1 year experience with cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)

* Master's Degree
* 7\+ years of experience in at least one of the following: JavaScript, Java, TypeScript, SQL, Python, or Go

**About WRITER**


WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI\-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise\-wide transformation. With WRITER's end\-to\-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise\-grade LLMs. Valued at $1\.9B and backed by industry\-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.


Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

 **About the role**


We're looking for an exceptional software engineer to join our rapidly evolving team at WRITER. In this pivotal role, you'll be at the forefront of expanding human capacity by building the next generation of AI\-powered solutions that transform how leading enterprises operate. You'll dive deep into developing a state\-of\-the\-art platform that leverages cutting\-edge generative AI technologies, from large language models to sophisticated agentic workflows, delivering seamless, scalable, and secure applications that redefine enterprise productivity. This is an unparalleled opportunity to make a tangible impact, shaping the future of AI and contributing to a product that’s changing how the world works.


This role is hybrid, based out of our San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle hubs. You'll report to our senior director, engineering .

**What you’ll do**

* Design and deliver secure, scalable AI integration platforms that connect enterprise systems and power mission\-critical automation.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of our AI integration client ecosystem, defining how AI applications securely connect to external tools, data sources, and enterprise systems.
* Own backend service design for high\-throughput, low\-latency APIs that enable reliable agent workflows and complex cross\-system orchestration.
* Set technical direction for identity, auth, and trust boundaries across integrations (OAuth, API key, service\-to\-service), balancing developer velocity with security and compliance.
* Partner with product and cross\-functional engineering leaders to shape roadmap, define technical strategy, and translate ambiguous business goals into durable platform capabilities.
* Lead production excellence through a metrics\-first reliability strategy, defining and enforcing SLOs/SLAs, maturing observability, and driving resilience, incident readiness, and performance optimization at scale.
* Raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, pragmatic design standards, rigorous testing strategy, and mentorship of senior and mid\-level engineers.

**️ What you need**

* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems using Typescript, Deno, Node.js, or Bun; scope and leveling can flex across Senior to Staff based on architectural impact and leadership.
* Strong experience designing and shipping API\-driven platform services and distributed systems, including microservices, event\-driven patterns, and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Practical expertise building AI integration layers (e.g., MCP clients/servers, tool orchestration, external API connectors, auth mediation), not just prompt or model experimentation.
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of authentication and security patterns for third\-party integrations (OAuth2/OIDC, API keys, token lifecycle, secret management, least\-privilege access).
* Proven cloud\-native experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including containerized workloads (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD, and production operations.
* Strong experience with observability and reliability engineering, including defining/operating service metrics, SLOs/SLAs, alerting, incident response, and performance tuning.
* Solid backend fundamentals in modern server frameworks and data systems (e.g., TypeScript/Node or Python ecosystems, PostgreSQL), with ability to choose the right tool for the system; experience with Python is a plus but not required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity: partner cross\-functionally, mentor engineers, drive technical decisions, and own delivery from design through production.
* You embody our core values of Connect, Challenge, and Own. You build strong partnerships across teams, challenge conventional thinking to drive innovation, and take ownership of your work with a focus on delivering meaningful impact and excellence.

CoreWeave is seeking a passionate and innovative **Senior Software Engineer of Network Services** to lead the architecture, scaling, and operations of our network services. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, public servants, and service members for decades.


Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter\-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years.


This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.


Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.


We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning.


That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours.


This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes.
* Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes.
* Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building.
* Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools.
* Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips
* Back up the deployment team during an implementation

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority
* Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo
* Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it
* Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it
* The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one
* Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work
* Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess
* Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them
* Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health \& Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family \& Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office \& Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Company\-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. For remote employees, $100/month dedicated to gym or physical fitness reimbursement.

**Stipends**

* $100/month utility stipend.
* $500/year professional development.
* $250/year recreation.
* $300/quarter pet care stipend.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

*Thank you for your interest in BAE Systems! This opening is included as part of our September 2026 Defense Electronics Engineering Hiring Event. While we encourage all interested professionals to apply, please note that this is a selection\-based interview event for candidates whose skills and experience match our hiring needs. If your background and skill set match these needs, we will reach out with next steps. If selected for an interview, specific opportunities based on your interests, experience, and skill set will be discussed with the hiring team. For candidates not local to the northern New Jersey area, virtual interviews will be accommodated.*
  

  

Our Charter: Deter. Impede. Detect. Respond.
  

  

Our Mission: Safeguard the United States' most critical technologies from exploitation to maintain our battlefield pre\-eminence.
  

  

Our Need: Creative and innovative engineers with prior embedded software engineering or systems security experience who can design and develop innovative security solutions on the most complex processors.
  

  

BAE Systems is currently seeking creative, innovative problem solvers to be part of a system security engineering focused group. In a modern approach to “Spy vs Spy,” BAE Systems uses state\-of\-the\-art technology, advanced mathematics, and physics in novel ways to protect our systems and provide our customers with capability that endures. Our engineers design solutions that achieve the optimum balance between product capability and defense\-in\-depth security. They apply all the lessons learned to our model\-based design approach and frequently advance security state\-of\-the\-art. They take their creative and innovative spirit to the extreme by playing the part of adversary through their identification of attack vectors. They propose countermeasures that provide the greatest protection at the best value for the system’s entire lifecycle.

* Work with Security State of the Art (S\-SOTA) technologies.
* Provide our customers with sophisticated, defense\-in\-depth security solutions.
* Work with NIST cryptographic algorithms

* Defining embedded software architectures
* Integrating software on complex processors
* Technical leadership of a software development
* Writing System Requirements
* Defining System Architectures
* Integrating Hardware and Software
* Validating and Verifying the delivered solution
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Cryptographic algorithm implementation
* Configuring security features of Commercial\-Off\-The\-Shelf (COTS) S\-SOTA components
* Firmware development for COTS S\-SOTA components such as Xilinx or Microsemi FPGAs
* Applying secure coding practices, securing operating systems, and virtualization
* Implementing and configuring security protocols
* Model\-Based Systems Engineering using Cameo or MagicDraw
* Developing positive customer relationships
* Product design development and design analysis for manufacturability and maintainability
  

  

  

*\#ESCSE*

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Bessemer Trust is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join its Application Delivery team. As a Software Engineering Intern, you will have the opportunity to work alongside our talented team of engineers to develop, enhance, and maintain software solutions that drive our wealth management services. This role offers hands\-on experience in software development, exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, and the chance to contribute to real projects that have a direct impact on the business.



Application Delivery is at the forefront of our firm's technology innovation, driving the creation and deployment of cutting\-edge applications that align with our strategic business goals. Our team is passionate about building high\-impact solutions using modern engineering principles and a meticulously crafted application reference architecture. We thrive on collaboration, working together with business leaders, advisors, investment professionals, and other colleagues to deliver solutions that make a tangible difference.



As part of our team, you'll be immersed in a technology ecosystem where your contributions are not just valued, but essential. Our tech stack is diverse and powerful, giving interns the unique opportunity to dive into various technical areas—from crafting intuitive front\-end experiences and designing robust APIs to architecting resilient back\-end systems and leveraging the latest in cloud computing. Join us and be a part of a team that's shaping the future of wealth management through innovation and excellence.


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Software Development: Assist in the design, development, and testing of software applications. This includes coding, debugging, and collaborating with team members on software solutions.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams including business analysts, testers and business areas directly to understand requirements and deliver high\-quality software.
* Problem Solving: Analyze and troubleshoot software issues, identifying and implementing solutions in a timely manner.
* Code Reviews: Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to best practices, and continuous learning.


**Qualifications:**


* Education: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C\#, or JavaScript.
* Knowledge: Basic understanding of software development principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming.
* Analytical Skills: Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work with complex technical concepts.
* Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work tasks.
* Knowledge of one or more of the following:
* Web development frameworks (e.g., React or Angular).
* Database systems (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).
* Version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) is a plus.
* Experience with generative AI technologies is a plus


**What We Offer:**


* Hands\-on experience with real\-world projects.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced software engineers.
* Exposure to the financial services industry and wealth management.
* Networking opportunities within the firm.


**The Bessemer Trust Internship Program:**



Our summer internship program offers real world experience working side\-by\-side with experts from departments and offices across our firm. Working within your designated team, you will manage individual and group projects, interact with senior leaders, network with fellow interns, and attend a variety of career development sessions virtually and in person at our New York headquarters. Throughout the program, you will receive ongoing coaching and guidance from your supervisor to support your development, help you navigate your responsibilities, and set you up for success.

**Company Information and Culture:**



Bessemer Trust is a family office, overseeing $250 billion in assets for over 3,000 individuals and families of substantial wealth. Its more than 1,300 employees are singularly focused on private wealth management — disciplined investment management, sophisticated wealth planning, comprehensive family office services, and highly personalized client service.



Established in 1907 as the family office for Annie and Henry Phipps, Bessemer Trust is in its seventh generation of ownership by the Phipps family. As a self\-made entrepreneur, Henry Phipps was a founding partner and chief financial officer of Carnegie Steel.



Bessemer Trust retains its original focus as a privately owned and independent wealth manager deeply committed to its mission of providing peace of mind to its clients. Bessemer's adherence to putting clients' interests first, fiduciary mindset, and highly collaborative culture are at the heart of everything the firm does.


**Key Facts:**


* For 119 years, Bessemer Trust has operated continuously in a single line of business, independently owned by one family.
* Headquartered in New York's Rockefeller Center, Bessemer Trust has 22 offices in total. Woodbridge, NJ, is one of the firm's largest offices, which hosts a wide range of technology and operations professionals. In addition to its sizable presence in New York and Woodbridge, the firm provides client service through offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Delaware, Denver, Garden City, Grand Cayman, Greenwich, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Naples, Nevada, Palm Beach, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Stuart, and Washington, D.C.
* To watch a video about Bessemer Trust's history, click here.
* To learn more about Bessemer Trust, click here.


*The hourly rate for this position ranges from $40\.00 \- $45\.00\.* *This range reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Application deadline is October 6th.*

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.


As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Community and Consumer Banking, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989\. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.


Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**


Millennium’s Infrastructure organization is dedicated to designing, engineering, supporting, and managing a robust server estate, systems virtualization, and core enterprise services. The WorldQuant Aligned Infrastructure team is a highly specialized group of talented, humble engineers from diverse disciplines. The team is focused on delivering exceptional services through meaningful changes across the technology stack, solving real business challenges, reducing operational complexity, and fostering a collaborative, team\-driven environment that promotes mutual growth and success.

* Design, code, and implement proprietary systems and tools that bring research ideas to life and deliver meaningful business impact.
* Collaborate daily with quantitative researchers to understand their needs and translate complex ideas into well\-engineered solutions that support research and production workflows.
* Build, extend, and maintain production\-quality software across the stack, primarily in Python and with contributions to C\+\+ codebases.
* Solve complex algorithmic and data\-structure problems where both correctness and performance are critical.
* Participate in code reviews and design discussions, and promote engineering best practices, code quality, and clear technical thinking.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs and decisions clearly with engineers and quantitative researchers, bridging research ideas and production code.

* A strong foundation in data structures and algorithms, with the ability to reason about complexity, select the right approach, and implement solutions cleanly.

* A deep commitment to code quality, correctness, and clear thinking, along with curiosity and a willingness to learn and investigate unfamiliar problems.
* A collaborative, team\-oriented approach and the ability to engage effectively with domain experts in technical discussions.
* C\+\+ experience, or a strong willingness and ability to ramp up quickly; prior exposure to quantitative finance, scientific computing, research\-focused environments, or performance\-sensitive and numerically oriented code is preferred.

**Salary Range**


Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines

* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using Claude Agent SDK including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions or MCP integrations
* At least 1 year of hands\-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models
* At least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability and usability of AI solutions
* 1\+ years of experience leading project workstreams or engagement, translating business problems into AI solutions and delivering measurable outcomes
* 4\+ years of hands\-on full\-stack development experience using at least one back\-end language such as Python, Java, .NET, Go, or Node.js and at least one modern front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* 4\+ years of experience in a client\-facing development role, including 2\+ years building and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) and/or GraphQL application programming interfaces.

jobs.description:
**Software Engineer II with Anthropic AI Experience, AI \& Engineering/Engineering as a Service**  

  

Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi\-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.  

  

Join our **AI \& Engineering** team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.  

  

**AI \& Engineering** leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/1/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Consultant, Software Engineer II, on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and delivering full\-stack software and AI\-enabled solutions for client engagements.
  

* Design, build, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack features across front\-end and back\-end systems.
* Develop and support microservices, application programming interfaces, continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code.
* Integrate large language model platforms and generative artificial intelligence application programming interfaces, including Anthropic Claude, to deliver context\-aware features, retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines, tool\-calling workflows, and automation solutions.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions, estimate work, and contribute to code reviews.
* Troubleshoot defects, improve application performance, write automated tests, and support production readiness activities, including incident response and on\-call rotations.

  

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models\-traditional teams, pools, or pods\-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on full\-stack development, including 3\+ years of full system lifecycle development from requirements through production deployment.
* 3\+ years of experience designing, developing and delivering AI/ML solutions
* At least 6 months of hands\-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using Claude Agent SDK including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions or MCP integration
* At least 6 months of hands\-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models
* At least 6 months of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability and usability of AI solutions
* 3\+ years of hands\-on full\-stack development experience using at least one back\-end language such as Python, Java, .NET, Go, or Node.js and at least one modern front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* 2\+ years of experience in a client\-facing development role, including 2\+ years building and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) and/or GraphQL application programming interfaces.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and one year of hands\-on experience integrating Anthropic Claude application programming interfaces into software applications in a commercial setting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

  

Preferred:
  

* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment using tools such as Jira or Linear.
* Contributions to open\-source projects or a portfolio demonstrating software development work.
* Industry\-recognized

jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer (173322)
jobs.description:
Requisition ID **173322** \- Posted **09/08/2026** \- **Information Technology** \- **United States** \- **New Jersey** \- **Piscataway** \- **Colgate\-Palmolive** \- **Travel \- up to 10% of time** \- **Hybrid**  

  

No Relocation Assistance Offered
  

Job Number \#173322 \- Piscataway, New Jersey, United States
  

  

**Who We Are**
  

  

Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  

  

Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.  

  



**Why Colgate\-Palmolive?**
---------------------------


At Colgate\-Palmolive, we are **brightening the future** of global consumer goods through digital transformation, modern engineering, and technical empowerment. We aren't just manufacturing household brands that put a smile on millions of faces—we are reinventing how real\-time data flows through our global supply chain.


As our Sr. Data Engineer, you are a hands\-on technical driver who bridges business strategy and data engineering, working side\-by\-side with our Data Architect to build and ship high\-performance data products on time. Instead of managing from the sidelines, you will dive deep into code to unblock engineers, optimize data pipelines, and keep our supply chain logistics running seamlessly so products reach store shelves clean and fresh.


**This position is based out of the Piscataway, NJ location. Work visa sponsorship is** **not available** **for this position.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**The Impact You’ll Make**
--------------------------


* Serve as the hands\-on lead resolving technical blockers across Python, SQL, Snowflake, and dbt pipelines.
* Act as primary backup to the Data Architect, performing GitHub PR reviews to enforce testing, quality, and platform standards.
* Ensure all engineering aligns with modern cloud data warehousing and orchestration standards (Airflow / GKE).
* Deliver high\-impact datasets for core metrics (OTIF, Forecast Accuracy, Inventory) sourced from SAP, Kinaxis, and WMS/TMS tools.
* Manage sprint backlogs, project timelines, internal engineers, and third\-party consultants across concurrent initiatives.

**What You'll Bring to The Team**
---------------------------------


### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related quantitative field.
* **5\+ years in Data Engineering**
* Hands\-on experience with Python, SQL, dbt, Airflow.
* Data Warehouse experience (**Snowflake** preferred).

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Background in Consumer Packaged Goods or high\-volume retail/logistics environments.
* Exposure to automated testing tools like Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, or dbt tests.
  

  

**Compensation and Benefits**
  

Salary Range $115,200\.00 \- $174,000\.00 USD
  

  

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit\-sharing, and long\-term incentives for Executive\-level roles.
  

  

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.
  

  

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
  

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.
  

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
  

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Data Engineer III (AI/BI)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  

  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  

  

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  

  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Position Summary:**


Join a groundbreaking team at Bank of America, at the forefront of innovation in AI. We are building the next generation of Gen AI platform, empowering new AI initiatives across Consumer, Small Business, Global Banking, and Wealth organizations. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a critical platform that will enable secure, scalable, and high\-performance AI capabilities across the organization. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.


This position is focused on design, build, and serve the Gen AI BI capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to shape the enterprise data ecosystem by establishing governance standards, improving data discoverability, enabling self\-service capabilities, supporting platform tenants, and ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant usage of data platform technologies. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data governance and metadata management with a strong customer\-centric mindset focused on platform adoption and business value realization.
  

This role is responsible for defining and leading the governance, adoption, onboarding, and tenant support strategy for enterprise data platforms while partnering with engineering, architecture, risk, and business stakeholders to drive enterprise\-wide outcomes.


This job is responsible for driving efforts to develop and deliver complex data solutions to accomplish technology and business goals. Key responsibilities include leading code design and delivery tasks with the integration, cleaning, transformation and control of data in operational and analytical data systems. Job expectations include liaising with vendors and working with stakeholders and Product and Software Engineering teams to implement data requirements, analyzing performance, and researching and troubleshooting issues within system engineering domains.


**Responsibilities:**

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The Systems Engineer is responsible for the analysis, design, security, and long\-term operation of the systems that support UDHG’s corporate and manufacturing locations. The position works with business users, IT, cybersecurity, and plant personnel to understand system requirements and develop technical solutions that meet those needs.
This position serves as the technical owner for assigned infrastructure platforms. The Systems Engineer evaluates technical options, develops system specifications, establishes standards, and makes recommendations concerning architecture, security, capacity, availability, and disaster recovery.  

The primary focus of the position is infrastructure engineering and systems analysis. Routine help desk tickets, basic end\-user support, printer maintenance, and equipment installation are handled by Level 1 and Level 2 support resources. The Systems Engineer becomes involved when an issue requires advanced analysis, a system change, or a permanent technical solution. **Key Responsibilities****Systems Analysis and Design*** Meet with business, IT, cybersecurity, and personnel to understand operational needs and translate them into system requirements.
* Analyze existing systems and identify changes needed to improve security, availability, capacity, performance, or supportability.
* Design and document infrastructure solutions involving servers, virtualization, storage, cloud services, identity, networking, backups, and disaster recovery.
* Develop system specifications, architecture diagrams, configuration standards, testing plans, implementation plans, and rollback procedures.
* Evaluate technical alternatives and recommend solutions based on business need, security risk, cost, system compatibility, and long\-term support requirements.
* Test and modify infrastructure systems before changes are placed into production.
* Determine the technical approach for assigned infrastructure projects within established IT and security policies.


**Infrastructure Engineering*** Design, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments and related infrastructure services.
* Serve as the technical owner for Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, and other assigned Windows services.
* Design and maintain VMware ESXi and Proxmox virtualization environments, including virtual machines, clusters, storage, replication, and capacity planning.
* Plan and lead server, operating\-system, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Review system performance, capacity, backup results, security events, and availability trends to identify risks before they interrupt operations.
* Develop and maintain technical standards for server configuration, virtualization, patching, backups, access, monitoring, and recovery.
* Design and test backup, restoration, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity procedures.
* Lead the technical work associated with infrastructure migrations, system replacements, new\-location deployments, and company integrations.


**Microsoft Cloud and Identity*** Design and maintain Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, and hybrid identity services.
* Establish standards for user access, authentication, role\-based permissions, multifactor authentication, and conditional access.
* Review access and identity configurations for security, consistency, and business need.
* Design and maintain endpoint\-management solutions using Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, or similar platforms.
* Develop automation using PowerShell or other appropriate tools to reduce manual administration and improve consistency.
* Evaluate changes to Microsoft cloud services and determine their effect on UDHG systems and users.


**Network and Security Engineering*** Analyze network requirements involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, Wi\-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, and remote access.
* Design or recommend changes to corporate LAN, WAN, wireless, and remote\-access environments.
* Establish technical requirements for network segmentation, access controls, monitoring, and secure remote connectivity.
* Review network performance and security data to identify capacity concerns, recurring problems, and potential risks.
* Work with cybersecurity personnel to evaluate vulnerabilities, determine remediation methods, and plan infrastructure security improvements.
* Perform root\-cause analysis following significant or recurring infrastructure incidents and develop permanent corrective actions.


**IT and OT Infrastructure*** Serve as the infrastructure engineering resource for systems that connect corporate IT services with manufacturing OT environments.
* Work with the OT Systems Engineer to define ownership, access, security, connectivity, backup, and recovery requirements for shared systems.
* Design infrastructure supporting OT\-related servers, virtual machines, storage, identity services, backups, and network connectivity.
* Develop and maintain secure separation between corporate IT and plant\-floor OT networks.
* Review proposed infrastructure changes for their effect on production systems and manufacturing operations.
* Coordinate joint IT and OT incident response when an event affects shared infrastructure.
* Ensure changes to production\-controlled systems are reviewed and approved by the appropriate OT owner before implementation.


**Projects and Technical Decisions*** Lead infrastructure projects from requirements gathering through design, testing, implementation, and post\-implementation review.
* Develop project scope, technical requirements, resource needs, risks, and implementation schedules.
* Evaluate infrastructure products, service providers, and vendor proposals.
* Provide technical recommendations for system purchases, renewals, replacements, and service agreements.
* Make or recommend decisions that affect infrastructure security, availability, capacity, cost, and business continuity.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Data Engineer to join our forward\-thinking data team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and architectures that support our business intelligence and analytics initiatives. Your expertise will enable seamless data integration across diverse platforms, empowering stakeholders with reliable, timely insights. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge big data systems and cloud technologies, driving data\-driven decision\-making at a global scale.

**Duties**

* Develop and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipelines using tools such as Informatica, Talend, or custom scripting in Python and Bash to ensure efficient data flow from source systems to data warehouses.
* Design and implement robust data models and schemas utilizing dimensional modeling principles for data warehousing solutions.
* Manage and maintain cloud\-based big data systems on platforms like AWS, Azure Data Lake, or other public cloud environments to support scalable analytics solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate linked data sources and develop comprehensive data management strategies that enhance data quality and accessibility.
* Build and maintain SQL databases including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud databases; optimize query performance for business intelligence tools like Looker.
* Contribute to the development of analytics models through model training techniques and support analysis efforts using SQL, Python, or other programming languages.
* Support agile development processes by participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives for data engineering projects.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience designing and implementing large\-scale big data systems using Hadoop, Spark, Apache Hive, or similar frameworks.
* Strong proficiency in SQL programming with extensive knowledge of SQL databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or cloud\-based alternatives.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms including AWS (Amazon Web Services), Azure Data Lake, or equivalent public cloud services.
* Expertise in software development practices with languages such as Java, Python, VBA, Bash (Unix shell), or Shell Scripting for automation and pipeline development.
* Familiarity with business intelligence tools like Looker or similar platforms for reporting and visualization purposes.
* Solid understanding of data modeling concepts including dimensional modeling for data warehousing design and query management strategies.
* Knowledge of ETL pipeline development using tools like Informatica or Talend; experience with RESTful APIs for integrating external data sources is a plus.
* Strong analysis skills combined with a keen eye for detail to ensure high\-quality data management and integration solutions.
* Experience working within an Agile environment to deliver iterative improvements efficiently.

Join us to be part of a passionate team dedicated to transforming raw data into actionable insights that propel our organization forward!

Pay: $40\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

We are growing our Applied AI org and seeking Machine Learning Engineers with expertise in model training, evaluation, and production\-oriented ML systems. This is a rare chance to join an early team with the autonomy, flexibility, and compute to tackle frontier science problems.



Applied AI sits at the intersection of AI Research, model engineering, and product deployment. The team partners closely with AI Researchers and Software teams to adapt Lila models to customer workflows, improve model quality through experimentation, and ensure model behavior works well end to end inside the application.



This role is ideal for someone who can bridge research and engineering: training or adapting models, building evaluation loops, debugging model behavior, and collaborating across AI and Software to move promising capabilities into production\-quality systems.

* Close the last\-mile gap between Lila AI model capabilities and customer\-specific scientific workflows.

* Partner with AI researchers to translate model improvements into usable capabilities.

* Experience building, training, adapting, or evaluating machine learning models.

* Experience working across research and engineering teams to move ML capabilities into usable systems.
* Familiarity with large language models, multi\-modal models, or agentic AI systems.

* Experience with scientific, technical, or data\-intensive customer use cases.
* Experience building evaluation harnesses, model monitoring, or quality dashboards.
